entities.title: A shared, replay-checked high-score table for MEG
entities.summary: High scores stay in each player's browser. A table shared across players, like the other games', needs the server to replay each run.
acceptanceCriteria: The simulation draws random numbers only from a seeded generator and uses only + − × ÷ and Math.sqrt, as AGENTS.md requires of engines the server replays.
A Worker API issues seeds and accepts recordings, replays them and keeps the table in a D1 database, with its migration.
A public scores page, as the other games have.

origin.description: The owner asked for MEG to be published on icelander.net; it went up with a per-device table.
